Recordings get their name without being opened.

**Automatic names in the background** (#756)

- When a meeting ends, or an uploaded recording is saved, Parley now names it and suggests a folder in the background, the way the phone apps already do. Before, a recording kept its "即時會議 · <date>" name until you opened it.
- Recordings from the last 7 days that still have no name are named shortly after Parley starts.
- If you rename a recording while Parley is naming it, your name is kept. Turning off automatic analysis in Settings turns this off too.
